statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the To header field in the request did not contain a tag, the UAS MUST add a tag to the To header field in the response (with the exception of the 100 (Trying) response, in which a tag MAY be present).

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The same tag MUST be used for all responses to that request, both final and provisional (again excepting the 100 (Trying)).
statements.guard_semantics: response.To-tag = initial_response.To-tag for all responses where response.status != 100

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the To header field in the request did not contain a tag, the UAS MUST add a tag to the To header field in the response (with the exception of the 100 (Trying) response, in which a tag MAY be present). This serves to identify the UAS that is responding, possibly resulting in a component of a dialog ID.
statements.trigger: send non-100 response when request.To-tag absent
actions: add To-tag to response To header field

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a request contained a To tag in the request, the To header field in the response MUST equal that of the request.
actions: copy To header field from request to response
